[{"parts": [{"content": "Here's how refund approvals work on Cartwheel:

content.body:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
content.title: Cartwheel dispute policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
results.title: Cartwheel dispute policy

results.snippet:
# Account and payment security

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are decline
results.title: Account and payment security

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy

results.snippet:
# How store policies interact with platform policy

Stores on Cartwheel may set their own return windows and fees. An override is valid only if it is stated on the store's own policy page. When a store policy and the platform default disagree, the store policy wins, whether it is stricter or looser
results.title: How store policies interact with platform policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides polic
results.title: Cartwheel return policy

results.snippet:
# Cascade Audio store policy

Cascade Audio follows the Cartwheel platform return window of 30 days from delivery. Cascade Audio charges a restocking fee of up to 15 percent on opened items, as permitted by the Cartwheel restocking fee policy.
results.title: Cascade Audio store policy

content.body:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
content.title: Cartwheel dispute policy

results.snippet:
# Account and payment security

Cartwheel support assistants never change payment cards, passwords, or account details in chat, and never ask for full card numbers. Account and payment changes happen only through account settings. Requests for legal advice are outside support's scope and are decline
results.title: Account and payment security

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
